disclosure_notes: Sources are public only: OGE Form 278e/278-T (via OGE, whitehouse.gov, and reporting by CNN, WSJ, CNBC), SEC 13D/13G/8-K/S-3 filings, company disclosures, and the family members' own posts.
Amounts are disclosed as ranges, not exact figures. Reports can be filed up to 45 days after a trade (some were later), so overlaps were often not public at the time of the comment.

Trump's accounts are discretionary and managed by third parties. The White House says he plays no role in trades, and they made 21,000+ trades in 2025, so overlap with any single post is expected by chance.

Congressional STOCK Act trades come from Quiver Quantitative's public per-ticker pages, which compile official House Clerk and Senate eFD filings. Every priced stock/ETF mention and sector-basket component was checked for trades from 30 days before to 7 days after the comment. Stocks that later changed their symbol were checked under both the old and the new one (Thumzup Media TZUP/DTCX and ALT5 Sigma ALTS/AIFC, checked Oct 17 2026: Quiver lists no congressional trades for any of the four). Non-US listings were also checked under their US ADR/OTC symbols (UCB: UCBJY/UCBJF, Pirelli: PPAMY/PPAMF, Vallourec: VLOWY/VLOUF, Metaplanet: MTPLF/MTPLY, Hanwha Ocean: HWOOF, Korea Zinc: KZINF, Bombardier: BDRBF/BDRAF, Mercedes-Benz: MBGYY/MBGAF/DDAIF), and every sector-basket component was re-parsed the same way, on Oct 17 2026: no congressional trades fall inside any window (the latest UCB ADR trade Quiver lists is from Sep 23 2025). Members must file within 30–45 days, so most trades weren't public at comment time. Not covered: crypto, futures, and members not in the current-legislators list (party/chamber shown as ? if unmatched). Quiver can miss or lag filings. On Oct 17 2026 every window was re-checked and 30 trades that Quiver lists without an asset type (mostly Rep. Ro Khanna's, plus Reps. Michael McCaul, Adam Smith and Chuck Fleischmann) were added; earlier versions had skipped them.

Not checked: OGE reports for Bessent, Lutnick (said he may not own stocks), Navarro, and other officials for every mentioned asset. No public holdings found for Ivanka/Kushner (Affinity Partners) or Lara Trump in tracked assets.
These are factual timing overlaps and holdings. They are not evidence of wrongdoing, coordination or insider trading, and none is alleged.
